## Setup Renv and Install Dependencies

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Setup: Environment Bootstrap, renv, Paths, and Global Options
# NOTE: When it asks "What would you like to do?" and provides you three options, choose # 1

# Clear active workspace memory for a clean session
rm(list = ls())

# Make sure 'here' is available first so we can use it for path checks
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("here", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
library(here)

# Automatic renv Bootstrap & Activation
if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("renv", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

if (!file.exists(here("renv.lock"))) {
  message("No renv.lock found. Initializing fresh renv environment...")
  renv::init(project = here(), bare = TRUE, prompt = FALSE)
} else {
  # Automatically restore project dependencies from lockfile without prompting
  message("Restoring renv environment from lockfile...")
  renv::load(project = here())
  renv::restore(prompt = FALSE)
}

# Force knitr and R Markdown / Quarto to run all chunks from the project root
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here())

# Set global chunk display and figure options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,          # Show code chunks in final report
  warning = FALSE,      # Hide package execution warnings
  message = FALSE,      # Hide library load startup messages
  fig.width = 8,        # Standardize figure width
  fig.height = 5,       # Standardize figure height
  fig.align = "center"  # Center plot outputs
)

# Source additional project dependency checks if needed
if (file.exists(here("code+nb/install_deps.R"))) {
  source(here("code+nb/install_deps.R"))
}
```
